bibliographic.title: Stories of Command Line - Teaching of Nmap
bibliographic.author: HEYANG LIU
bibliographic.description:
You are James, a cybersecurity intern at Blueshield Corporation. Under the mentorship of Alex, a seasoned network administrator, you will embark on a journey into the world of network reconnaissance. Learn and master the Nmap command-line tool through interactive scenarios simulating real-world network environments.

Explore IP configurations, scan subnets, identify open ports and services, probe for vulnerabilities, and discover hidden parts of the digital infrastructure. Your choices and accuracy will impact your final score and rating.

This game blends educational content with immersive narrative to teach fundamental skills in ethical hacking and cybersecurity operations.

Features:
  • 7 chapters covering key concepts in Nmap scanning
  • Real command syntax simulation
  • Scoring and evaluation system
  • A mentor-led storyline with progressive learning


No prior knowledge of Nmap is required, but attention to detail is rewarded. Can you reach an S-rating and prove yourself as a future cybersecurity professional?
